title: Full Stack Software Engineer | TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, AWS, AI Agents
rtw: Full right to work in the UK until Feb 2028 (Graduate visa)
profile: Full Stack Software Engineer with 2.5+ years designing, building and supporting production web applications end to end, from database design and REST APIs to React and Next.js interfaces, cloud deployment and production support. Works in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python and SQL, with Node.js, FastAPI and Flask on the backend and PostgreSQL on AWS. Owns a platform used by 700+ residents across 14 projects, built an event-driven payments backend that processed 3,000+ orders in its first 2 days, and spent nearly two years building data-heavy analytics products. Builds AI agents and LLM applications with LangGraph, tool calling, MCP, RAG and vector search, and works AI-native with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex daily while reviewing all AI output. Has led and mentored junior developers, and works directly with non-technical stakeholders. MSc Computer Science, University of Warwick.

sections.name: Professional Experience
items: Remote (India-based company), building production platforms for client businesses
TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Docker, AWS

Owned the platform end to end for a construction and redevelopment company, from requirements and Figma designs to PostgreSQL data model, REST APIs, React interfaces, AWS deployment and production support. It now serves 700+ residents across 14 redevelopment projects.

Turned a vague client request into clear requirements, Figma screens for separate Resident and Admin panels, and a technical plan covering resident management, project tracking, documents and payments.
Designed the relational schema on AWS RDS PostgreSQL, added indexes, tuned slow queries and wrote database migrations as requirements evolved.
Built authentication with OTP verification, server-side role-based access control (RBAC), AES-256-GCM encryption for bank details and rate limiting at the API gateway.

Set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker deploying to AWS (EC2, API Gateway, S3, RDS), with logging and monitoring, and supported the platform in production, scaling vertically as residents were onboarded.
Traced slow page loads to their root cause, cutting the JavaScript bundle from 35 MB to 6 MB, fixing layout shift and raising the Lighthouse score from 56 to 90 with better accessibility and SEO.
Implemented resident document storage on AWS S3 and notifications over SMS and WhatsApp, reducing manual work and calls for the client team.
Use Claude Code daily alongside Cursor and Codex, choosing models and prompts per task, and review and test all AI-generated code before it ships. Started adding unit and integration tests.
Salad O'Clock: WhatsApp ordering and payments platform
Python, Flask, PostgreSQL, Razorpay, Interakt WhatsApp API, AWS CDK
Mapped a client's fully manual ordering process into a structured workflow and built the Python (Flask) REST APIs behind a WhatsApp ordering and checkout bot.
Built event-driven payment processing with Razorpay webhooks and asynchronous order status updates, with retries and timeouts on external API calls, and defined infrastructure with AWS CDK.
Launched with 3,000+ successful orders in the first 2 days and no reported issues, and the bot generated 75% more orders than the client's website.
Python, FastAPI, OpenAI, LangGraph, PostgreSQL, pgvector, CLIP, Pydantic, WhatsApp Business API
Architecting and building an AI shopping assistant with Python, FastAPI and LLMs, enabling natural-language product discovery and conversational shopping.

Engineered agentic workflows with tool calling for product search, inventory validation, size recommendations, cart management and checkout, using Pydantic models for structured tool inputs and outputs.
Implemented semantic product search with PostgreSQL and pgvector, and visual product discovery from customer screenshots using CLIP image embeddings and vector similarity search.
Designed database-driven inventory and pricing validation so the agent relies on real data, reducing AI-generated inaccuracies, and integrated the WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
Pune, India (blockchain analytics startup, built on a customised open-source Metabase)
Progressed from frontend development to owning features end to end, from Figma designs with the founder and CTO to Node.js REST APIs, TypeORM schemas and TypeScript interfaces.
Migrated the production front end from Angular to Next.js for server-side rendering (SSR) and better SEO, reducing page load latency by up to 60%.
Built data-heavy dashboards, data tables and visualisations with D3.js, Plotly.js and Chart.js, and an in-browser SQL editor for querying indexed on-chain data.
Queried indexed blockchain data from The Graph's substreams and indexers with GraphQL, and integrated REST APIs, managing state with Redux Toolkit.
Built reusable UI components and a shared component library with styled-components, and designed user flows, wireframes and mockups in Figma.
Played a major role in designing and building a multi-chain crypto checkout accepting USDC, USDT and DAI (ERC-20) across Ethereum, Arbitrum and Polygon, and integrated Stripe payments.
Implemented Web3 login with WalletConnect and MetaMask, verifying wallet signatures on the backend.
Reviewed smart contracts and built Node.js handlers with ethers.js to capture and process real-time contract events.
Built Telegram and Discord bots delivering real-time on-chain analytics, increasing user engagement by 35%.
Led a frontend team of junior developers and interns, assigning tasks with sprint estimates, reviewing code and mentoring them, and wrote documentation and handover notes.
Worked in Agile sprints with sprint planning, estimation and retrospectives, and ran services in Docker on Linux with Git and GitHub Actions.

sections.name: Projects
items: CineVerse: AI Movie and TV Assistant
Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, MCP, Google Gemini API, ChromaDB, TMDB API, Next.js, React, Vercel
Built a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline orchestrated in LangGraph: Gemini extracts intent and keywords, which are matched against a ChromaDB vector store and then live TMDB data.
Built a custom MCP server wrapping the TMDB REST API so the LLM agent chooses tools at runtime, and evaluated agent outputs against real user queries.
Served answers through a responsive Next.js and React interface with watchlists and genre filtering, deployed on Vercel.
DeFIX: Decentralised Exchange with Web3 Gaming
TypeScript, Solidity, Hardhat, Wagmi, WalletConnect, ethers.js, OpenSea API
Tested and deployed smart contracts with Hardhat for a decentralised exchange enabling ERC-20 token swaps, and built the dApp with Wagmi and WalletConnect plus an NFT-based PvP battle module.
Java, Java Servlets, JSP, HTML, MySQL, Maven

Built a Java web application to create customer quotations with automatic price calculation and PDF export, backed by a MySQL database. Also built Spring Boot mini projects and cross-platform mobile apps with React Native.
